none: PAS CAM-D09120: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Sesterius of Marcus Aurelius as Augustus (AD 161-180)
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SALVTI AVG COS III, S C ; D/ M ANTONINVS AVG TR P XXIIII

A copper-alloy Sesterius of Marcus Aurelius as Augustus (AD 161-180) (Reece period 8). Reverse legend reads SALVTI AVG COS III, S C. Reverse shows Salvs standing left, feeding snake at altar and holding sceptre. Mint is Rome (AD 169-170). RIC vol.III, p.292, no.979. Obverse legend reads M ANTONINVS AVG TR P XXIIII. Obverse shows Laureate head right. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 28.80g,…
